blocks.title: Warm-up: implementation, brute force, case analysis
blocks.notes: C++ contest template & fast IO; reading constraints -> complexity table; simulation; brute force; splitting into cases (Yoneda 1000->1400 skills)

blocks.title: Recursion & backtracking
blocks.notes: Recursion tree, base case, parameterised vs functional recursion; pick/not-pick; subsets/permutations templates; pruning; complexity of backtracking

blocks.title: Bit manipulation
blocks.notes: Binary representation, &,|,^,~,<<,>>; tricks (x&(x-1), lowbit, xor properties, prefix xor); bitmask subset enumeration

blocks.title: Sorting & greedy
blocks.notes: Exchange argument, sort-then-scan, interval scheduling, custom comparators, "stays sorted" invariants, proving a greedy choice

blocks.title: Prefix sums, hashing, two pointers, sliding window
blocks.notes: 1D/2D prefix sums, difference arrays, prefix+hashmap counting, two pointers (opposite/same direction), fixed & variable windows, "at most K" trick

blocks.title: Binary search mastery
blocks.notes: Monotonic predicate, first-true/last-true templates, BS on answer + feasibility check, real-valued BS, BS + greedy, BS on 2D

blocks.title: Number theory & combinatorics basics
blocks.notes: Divisibility, gcd/lcm & Euclid, sieve & SPF, prime factorisation, modular arithmetic, binary exponentiation, modular inverse (Fermat), nCr with factorials, stars & bars

blocks.title: DP I: 1D & grid DP
blocks.notes: Recursion -> memoisation -> tabulation -> space optimisation; state & transition design; counting vs optimisation DP

blocks.title: DP II: subsets & knapsack
blocks.notes: 0/1, unbounded and bounded knapsack; subset-sum family; order of loops (combinations vs permutations); dp over values vs weights

blocks.title: DP III: strings, LIS, stocks
blocks.notes: Two-string DP tables, reconstruction, LIS O(n log n), state machines (stocks), DP on DAGs

blocks.title: Graphs I: traversal, grids, components, cycles
blocks.notes: Adjacency list, BFS/DFS (recursive & iterative), grid as graph, connected components, bipartite check, cycle detection (undirected/directed), multi-source BFS

blocks.title: Heaps, sets & maps
blocks.notes: priority_queue patterns (k-th, merge k, greedy with heap), std::set/multiset/map, lower_bound on sets, two-heap median

blocks.title: Graphs II: topological sort & shortest paths
blocks.notes: Kahn/DFS topo sort, DP on DAG, 0-1 BFS, Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford, Floyd-Warshall; choosing the right SP algorithm

blocks.title: Graphs III: DSU & MST
blocks.notes: Union-find with path compression + union by size, offline connectivity, Kruskal & Prim

blocks.title: Trees & BSTs
blocks.notes: Rooted vs unrooted trees, DFS on trees (subtree sizes, depths, parents), diameter, rerooting intro, binary-tree recursion patterns, BST invariants

blocks.title: Strings, stacks & monotonic structures
blocks.notes: String handling in C++, frequency arrays, palindromes; stack/queue/deque; monotonic stack (next greater/smaller, contribution technique); monotonic deque

blocks.title: DP IV: intervals & classic hard DP
blocks.notes: Interval DP (MCM family), game DP, probability DP, prefix-sum optimised transitions, tree DP intro

blocks.title: Tries & string algorithms (KMP / Z / hashing)
blocks.notes: Trie insert/search/count, binary trie for XOR; prefix function (KMP), Z-function, polynomial hashing

blocks.title: Range queries: Fenwick tree & segment tree
blocks.notes: Sparse table, BIT (point update/range query, range update/point query), segment tree (point update, range query, walk on tree)

blocks.title: Advanced DP: bitmask, digit, tree & range DP
blocks.notes: Bitmask DP over subsets, digit DP state design, DP on trees (in/out, rerooting), range DP

blocks.title: Advanced graphs & trees: SCC, bridges, LCA, Euler tour
blocks.notes: Tarjan/Kosaraju SCC, bridges & articulation points, binary lifting LCA, Euler tour + segment tree, functional graphs
